title: Allans Music Group and Australian Music Group - completed merger

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the completed merger.

body_sections.Summary: Allans Music Groups and Australian Music Group have merged their businesses.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the completed merger within the context of: - a national market for the wholesale supply of musical instruments and accessories; and - metropolitan and regional markets for the retail supply of musical instruments and accessories. For the purposes of the competition analysis, the ACCC did not consider it necessary to form a definitive view regarding market definition.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the completed merger was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the merged entity would have a relatively small market share at both the retail and wholesale level, although would be the largest retailer in the industry post-merger; - the merged entity would continue to face competition from a number of competitors at both the retail and wholesale level; and - the absence of competitive overlap between the parties with regard to the wholesale supply of musical instruments and accessories.
